title: Houthis used Anthropic AI to try to build ballistic missiles

reading.body:
The incident record consists of one headline from one outlet, dated 11 September 2026, stating that Houthis used Anthropic AI to try to build ballistic missiles. The record contains no article text, so the claim itself cannot be examined. Nothing in it describes what the system was asked to do, how it was accessed, or what it produced.

If the claim held, the failure would be misuse rather than malfunction, a system used outside the conditions it was built for and by an actor it was not intended to serve. The record does not establish that. It also does not place the failure at any particular point in a deployment, whether at the model, at the access controls, or at the user. The headline names a maker and a user and stops there.

Catching this kind of use would depend on either a provider's own monitoring of how its systems are queried or on external reporting, and the record describes neither. What is not established is everything beyond the headline. There is no confirmed use, no finding by any authority, no stated consequence, and no evidence of intent. A single outlet's headline is a claim, not a verified account.
